native_population.formal: Each native frame constructs selected cache and inactive execGPU cache. Selected SLICE closes; extra registered caches emit no events and GLOBAL epoch_closed remains false. Exact global counter residual0 does not qualify a whole GPU. Real application must emit0..63 distinct physicalSLICE at terminal plus count64 GLOBAL and epoch_closed/exit/drain; missing records invalid.

phase_metadata.formal: PHASE counters are disjoint phase counts; epoch_closed/live_detached/closure_ok fields are cumulative slice metadata, not phase-local lifetime equations.

coverage_effect: Clarifies already enforced native fixture/global-vs-physical64slice and PHASE cumulative-parent metadata. No decoder equation/framing code change.
